about: Generated industry imagery for the A&P Dispensary redesign pitch. v2 'Morning Glass' (2026-11-02, after the operator's review of the dark v1): the eleven backdrop stills were regenerated on light grounds with the same ids and aspect ratios: bright, airy, high-key still lifes in soft morning sunlight from the upper left, soft shadows to the lower right, cream, paper-white and pale stone with a hint of sage, generous light negative space for type. The two cut-outs (g-leaf-cut, g-bud-cut) are kept from v1 unchanged; their exact v1 prompts (with the v1 style suffix) are in their sidecars. None stands in for A&P's store, street, staff, customers, products or results (A&P's own photos and footage cover the store); every alt describes what is depicted. Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project> --concurrency 3 --force <ids>.

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no fingers, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no stickers, no logos, no brand marks, no packaging print, no candy, no saturated colours, no neon, all surfaces blank and unmarked

images.negativeSpace: the cabinet stands right of centre; the left half is calm sunlit cream wall
images.alt: A slim black-framed glass display cabinet standing in a bright sunlit cream room, a few cured cannabis buds on its glass shelves, a window at the left and a potted plant at the right.
images.prompt: Bright, airy, high-key editorial still-life photograph in a sunlit room: a tall slim display cabinet with a thin matte black metal frame and clear glass panes and clear glass shelves stands right of centre against a smooth warm cream plaster wall on a pale stone floor; on two of its glass shelves rest a few dense cured cannabis flower buds, frosty trichomes catching the sun; the other shelves are empty; bright clean reflections on the glass; a softly blurred potted green plant in a pale ceramic pot stands at the far right edge. Composition: the cabinet occupies the right third of the frame, the whole left half of the frame is calm softly sunlit cream wall as light negative space. soft natural morning sunlight from a window at the upper left, gentle soft shadows falling to the lower right, warm cream, paper-white and pale stone tones with a hint of sage green, clean modern premium mood, crisp detail, full-bleed photograph edge to edge with no border and no frame; not a shop, no brick, no signage, no counter, no packaged goods

images.negativeSpace: light and haze in the centre and right; the left third and the bottom edge calm pale cream
images.alt: Tall frosted glass panels in soft morning light, pale cream with a faint mint tint, soft shadows of leaves falling across them.

Composition: haze, rays and glass concentrated in the centre and right, calm pale cream negative space on the left third and along the bottom edge. soft natural morning sunlight from a window at the upper left, gentle soft shadows falling to the lower right, warm cream, paper-white and pale stone tones with a hint of sage green, clean modern premium mood, crisp detail, full-bleed photograph edge to edge with no border and no frame; ethereal calm mood, nothing else in the frame, no objects, no plants, no furniture
